private_lines.Inès: You work as a junior architect at a small firm in Toulouse, spending your days on drawings, site visits, and client meetings. You live alone in a rented flat in the Saint-Cyprien district and usually head home after work to cook and unwind.
private_lines.Julien: You work as a sound engineer, mostly in studios and on location shoots around Toulouse, with irregular hours and freelance gigs. You live alone in a small flat in the Carmes area and fill your evenings with editing sessions or unwinding with records.
private_lines.Laure: You work as a graphic designer, freelancing from home and taking on agency projects across Toulouse. You live in a shared apartment in Saint-Aubin with two flatmates you met through work, and your days are split between client briefs and evenings out with them.

text: Who still has the biscuit tin from the flat
the blue one?
Yes. Broken lid 🙃
Idk 😭 I think it went with julien when we did the move out? Or it's in my parents' loft
not me. i have a box of cables and a tupperware of guitar picks. no tin
Ok. If it turns up tell me. Going to sleep
Sorry was in a brief. Will check my cupboards tmrw
the old flat had a cupboard under the stairs. not sure we ever cleared that
Omg the cupboard under the stairs 😭 is that where the bike pump was
bike pump was in the bathroom. no idea about the tin
no tin
[photo: a dented blue tin on a kitchen counter, lid held on with masking tape]
Found it behind the rice 😭 it's full of old pins. Do u want it
YES that's the one 🙌 can I pick it up saturday? I'm on site all week
Sat works. Only if you let me keep the pins 😂
those pins are from my poster phase. return them
Lmao no 📌
Site visit in the rain. Boots dead. The foundations are fine at least
recording a singer in a cellar by the canal. she has a cold and she's brilliant anyway
Is it the one from the cassette you played us last time? The one with the hiss
no that was another. this one's from a basement in Saint-Cyprien, the room sounds like a bathroom
the room sounds terrible but the take is good. going home
Morning. Boots still wet 😩
Can I come sat 11 or is that too early for you
11 is fine
pins stay with laure. i've made peace
Ok I'm awake and already behind 😭 brief has 14 revisions
Lmao pins stay till saturday then we fight at the door 📌
On site, eating a sandwich standing up in a skip shelter 😅
The foreman keeps saying "it's just a bit of damp" like it's a personality
[voice note: 0:11]
she sent that from her bathtub. the cold's still there but the voice is back
Done. 3 logos, client will pick the one I hated 🙃
Going to make pasta and pretend I'm not tired
[photo: a pair of brown boots drying on a radiator]
They smell like a dog now. Back on the radiator for the night
Boots are crispy now. Like a biscuit 😩
Ok that was a bad joke. Leaving for site
Client picked the one I hated. Obviously 🙃
Sending the files anyway. Revisions are my problem now
Told you the grey one was too safe
Wait, you said you hated it?
Yes. Hated it. Also paid for it 😭
Lol ok
mixed the cellar take. the bathroom reverb is still in it. i kinda love it
she's going to hate it
Send it to me, I'll tell you if it sounds like a bathroom
it sounds like a bathroom
Home. Mud on everything. Foreman now says "it's just a bit of mud" 😅
Saint-Aubin dinner went long. Flatmate made a cake shaped like a cat, no notes
does anyone know where the record player cable went
No idea. Check the cupboard under the stairs 😂
